name: n4_list_tag_dictionaries
description: List the tag dictionaries installed under the TagDictionaryService (one BQL query), each with its namespace, enabled, frozen, version and status, and what it defines: tag definitions (id, info type, value type, default, validity condition; type null for a smart tag the station computes), tag groups (id, the group_ord a tag group relation points at, the tags it implies) and relation ids. dictionary (a name such as Niagara, or a namespace such as n) lists one. max_items (default 200, at most 2000) bounds the definitions listed across all dictionaries; truncated says some were left out. Use it before n4_set_tags to see which tags, values and groups a station defines.
